paragraphs.text: Nautilus is a creature type for celaphods from the family Nautilidae
The marine nautilus is similar in general form to other cephalopods like squids and octopuses , with a prominent head and tentacles. They also have a spiral, chambered shell with pearly septa.
Nautiluses appear primarily in mono- blue , though Monoist Circuit-Feeder is mono- black .
The first card printed with that type was Crystalline Nautilus from Journey into Nyx .

The card Chambered Nautilus from Mercadian Masques was originally just a Beast . However, the creature type Nautilus was added in the Grand Creature Type Update ,retroactively making it the first nautilus in the game.
On Ixlaan, the Hermitic Nautilus is an artifact creature known to inhabit shells created by others. They will devour a shell’s original before taking up residence in it.
Mercadia is home to the Chambered Nautilus, which can grow to several feet in length. Saprazzan artisans were known to use their shells for exquisite jewelry.
Theros is home to the Crystalline Nautilus. They are seeminly able to ride across waves on top of the water.
The Edge is home to space-faring artifact creatures known as Monoist Circuit-Feeders. It said that they do to ships what the Monoist faith does to stars.
